body:
## Summary
- require file-transfer product E2E `remote_file` artifacts to retain the actual destination file bytes
- validate each retained remote file artifact size and SHA-256 against the direction manifest
- update focused evidence tests and gate docs so future Host-backed captures cannot close from checksum-only artifacts

## Verification
- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_file_transfer_android_smoke tools.tests.test_file_transfer_bulk_current_base_manifest tools.tests.test_file_transfer_bulk_current_base_gate -v` — 63 tests passed
- `git diff --check` — passed
- `make file-transfer-android-smoke EVIDENCE_DIR=.build/evidence/file-transfer-android-smoke-remote-file-check-3` — expected blocked readiness record: `verdict=blocked gate_closed=false blockers=8`
- Read-only P0110 probe confirmed `device`, `nubia`, `P0110`, `pacific`, Android `16`, SDK `36`, and no retained `tcp:54321` reverse output

## Boundaries
No Vibe Screen/MacHost/Telemachus GUI was launched. No `swift run`, Screen Recording, Accessibility, Microphone TCC, Keychain, System Settings, or `adb reverse tcp:54321 tcp:54321` command was used.

## Still blocked
This hardens the evidence gate only. Closing `file_transfer_android_product_e2e` still requires a current-source stable-signed/TCC-ready Host, a ready USB or trusted-LAN product path, current Android file-transfer instrumentation output, and retained bidirectional product evidence with sender action, receiver approval, file offer/request/content packets, destination file writes, matching endpoint SHA-256, positive session epoch, distinct transfer IDs/names/payloads, progress, and cancel cleanup.
title: test(evidence): verify file transfer remote artifacts
